ASRA

Autonomous Security Research Agent — launch

This .exe is running on its own — no ASRA project found above it.
GitHub Releases ships only this shell binary; it needs the full ASRA project (run.sh, the backend) installed alongside it. Pick a folder and this installs it there, then relaunches from the installed copy automatically.
ASRA installed to
The file you downloaded did its one job and removed itself -- this is the real app from now on. Feel free to pin it or make a shortcut to it; the whole folder can also be moved to a different drive/location later if you want, it'll keep working from wherever it ends up.
Launch mode
Run the agent as root
Runs inside WSL as root, skipping sudo for tools like nmap -O. Tip: to use privileged tools without root, set your sudo password beforehand in Advanced settings (SUDO_PASSWORD) or manually in .env.
System
Advanced settings — .env (toggles & fields; Save to remember for next time)
Saved
Open it in your browser with the button, or copy the address. ASRA opens the browser only on this explicit click — never on its own.
Stop the ASRA server?
This shuts down the server this launcher started. A scan that is still running is interrupted, and every browser tab with ASRA open stops working until you click Start again. Saved projects and findings stay on disk.
